Do you want to work for one of the largest production companies specialized in meat products? In the Vacuum department, you are responsible for packing and repacking semi-finished and finished products according to the regulations. Your main tasks are: - Performing production activities according to work instructions, procedures, and preparation methods - Checking whether the expiration date, packaging, and labels are correct - Identifying and reporting deviations to your supervisor - Feeding the product to be packed / placing it on the supply belt of the packaging, thermoforming, and vacuum machines - Removing packed finished products and placing them in storage using a pallet jack - Wrapping pallets with packed finished products and providing them with a pallet label - Performing cleaning work on the equipment and the work environment according to work instructions - Packing and repacking work - Performing quality checks You start between 05:00 and 08:00 AM, depending on the department, and the end time is flexible. You usually work 8-hour shifts, from Monday to Friday, but extra hours and extra days on the weekend are scheduled if business operations require it.  Job Requirements  - You are physically fit and able to do standing and lifting work. - You speak English and/or Dutch. - You can work in a team and independently. - You can work in a cold environment (7°C). - You are available during peak periods (December and Easter). - Willingness to adhere to regulations regarding jewelry, nail polish and artificial nails, which are prohibited in food production environments.
